Title: Seven Treatises, containing such direction as is gathered out of the Holie Scriptures, leading and guiding to true happiness, both in this life and in the life to come, and may be called the practise of Christianitie
Creator: Richard Rogers (1550?-1618), preacher of Wethersfield, Essex
Publisher: London (printer not named in the item metadata; the 1610 edition)
Publication Date: 1610
Rights: Public Domain (printed 1610, pd-us-by-date)
Source: Internet Archive item seven00roge, file seven00roge_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: the item metadata carries no possible-copyright-status field (contributor Princeton Theological Seminary Library, Collection of Puritan and English Theological Literature); rights rest on the 1610 date of the edition.
Provenance note: Header prepended; the OCR text follows unchanged apart from long-s (U+017F) to s, 0 replacements (none were present: this scan's OCR already renders the long s as f or s inconsistently, which is left as found). Rights basis restated: a 1610 London imprint is public domain in the United States by date.
Content note: SECOND WITNESS, not a clean quoting text (Mark's OCR ruling, 2026-09-25): early-modern print with systematic long-s misreads and marginal scripture references run into the lines; sampled at 10/30/50/70/90 per cent and found readable but garbled in every sample. The seven treatises run in sequence with chapter headings 'Chap. n' as printed (first chapter heading about line 991); the edition's dedication and address To the Christian Reader open the file. Use for locating passages; verify any quotation against the page images before it is relied on.
